description: Quick pop — element appear/spawn, chip/tag/badge in. Small precise accent, sync to the pop-in.
Quiet short click — low-key UI tap / soft selection. Short accent, sync exactly to the on-screen action.
Short whoosh — quick swipe/slide accent, fast element move, snappy transition. Sync to the motion.
Punchy whoosh/impact — fast reveal or hard transition accent. Sync to the motion.
Single key press — one keystroke / terminal-input beat. Short accent, sync to the typed character.
Sharp electronic ping — punchy accent on a key reveal or data point. Sync to the beat.
Typing burst (~1.5s of keys) — keyboard / code typing reveal, text-being-typed beat. Start as the text begins typing.
Bass impact hit — logo/hero snap, headline slam. Trigger on the visual landing; decay carries into the next shot (J-cut).
